title: Bowl with floral and geometric designs
alt: Painted pottery bowl from Faras with floral and geometric decoration
note: Meroitic pottery from Faras, Sudan. The museum record identifies no individual maker.

title: Untitled – four Faces of Eve
note: Oil on canvas. View the artwork and collection record at the source; image reproduction permission has not been established.

title: Composition
note: Oil on a calabash-ball surface: painting meets the form of a traditional vessel. Image displayed at the source.

title: Bowl
alt: Small copper-alloy bowl from Meroitic Faras
note: Copper-alloy vessel from Faras, Sudan. Individual maker unrecorded.

title: Abou Simbel, Nubia
alt: Historical photograph of the monumental statues at Abu Simbel
note: Albumen silver print from a glass negative. The historical title is retained; Abu Simbel is in present-day Egypt, not Sudan.

title: Jane Avril
alt: Jane Avril poster by Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec
note: Colour lithograph: a historical example of the meeting of art, performance and poster design.

title: Book cover
alt: Decorative silver book cover by Johann Jakob Bruglocher II
note: Silver with remains of gilding. A crafted binding rather than a modern printed book jacket.

title: Wheat Field with Cypresses
alt: Wheat field, cypress trees and swirling sky painted by Vincent van Gogh
note: An international selection alongside the Sudanese and Nubian works.
